◆ NL_AUTO_PORT

#define NL_AUTO_PORT   0

Will cause the netlink port to be set to the port assigned to the netlink socket just before sending the message off.

This macro is already defined in <netlink/msg.h> for some platforms, but not for others maybe because it was introduced at a later version of the library being used. Thus we define the macro if it's not already being defined.
